versions.short: The bill would direct the Director of the Office of Management and Budget to consider, during the next revision of the Standard Occupational Classification system, creating a separate code for direct support professionals, who help people with intellectual and developmental disabilities with daily living, independence, and community life. If the Director decides not to create that separate code, the bill would require a report to Congress explaining the decision within one month of that revision. The bill would not authorize any new funds.
